purpose: Verify that the Journal 1 condition labels used in maintained artefacts exactly match the canonical harness mapping in scripts/condition_comparison.py, and that Proposition J1-P1 (C1 ≡ C3) follows from that mapping without requiring the harness to run.

checks.check: specification_mapping is entry-wise identical to canonical_mapping
checks.evidence: All 12 cells (4 conditions × 3 states) match. Verified against scripts/condition_comparison.py A_AI dict (lines 90-105) and evaluation-specification.md Sections 3 and 4 tables.

checks.check: Proposition J1-P1 (C1 ≡ C3) holds at the admissible-set level
checks.proof: A_C1(SAFE)=FULL=A_C3(SAFE); A_C1(CAUTION)=FULL=A_C3(CAUTION); A_C1(UNSAFE)=EMPTY=A_C3(UNSAFE). Therefore for all S ∈ {SAFE,CAUTION,UNSAFE}, A_C1(S)=A_C3(S).
checks.evidence: Finite-mapping comparison over three states; no data required. Trace confirmation C1↔C3=0.00% (over 43,848 hours in both PRIMARY and RESOLUTION configurations) is a harness-consistency check, not a rediscovery.

checks.check: The old Journal-local label mapping (Journal C1/C2/C3 = Ungated/Binary/Proposed) has been retired in maintained artefacts
checks.evidence: condition-label-audit.csv records all 18 audited occurrences with their classification (OLD-J1-LABEL / CANONICAL-LABEL / HISTORICAL / IRRELEVANT) and the action taken. All OLD-J1-LABEL occurrences in maintained files (research-design.md, manuscript.md §10) were migrated to canonical labels. HISTORICAL occurrences (section-5-plan.md, section-6-plan.md) remain scoped by their existing superseded-audit banners.

checks.check: The most inversion-prone label (C2) is unambiguous: canonical C2 = Proposed, retired Journal-local C2 = Binary-gated
checks.evidence: All maintained artefacts now use canonical semantics: C2 = Proposed graduated architecture. No active result requires manual label translation.
